summary: Frontend-only login flow re-verification for LPK Hakusa Edu Japan. All 4 requested scenarios pass: (1) Correct admin credentials (admin@hakusa.id / HakusaAdmin2026) log in and land on Dashboard with page-title='Dashboard Keuangan' and total-saldo-display visible (Rp 531.483.757, 1498 transaksi). (2) Wrong credentials (hakusaedujapan@gmail.com / wrongpass) show data-testid=login-error with exact text 'Email atau password salah'. (3) Logout via logout-btn redirects to /login and re-login still works. (4) Mobile viewport 390x844 login succeeds and dashboard renders correctly. Only 1 wrong-password attempt made (well under 5-fail lockout threshold).
critical_code_review_comments: Original user confusion ('email dan password salah') was a UX issue, not a bug — users may try their own gmail. Consider adding a hint under the login form like 'Hubungi admin untuk membuat akun' or clearer error wording that distinguishes 'account not found' from 'wrong password' (currently both show same message, which is actually good for security but bad for UX in this closed-system context).
test_credentials: admin@hakusa.id / HakusaAdmin2026 (confirmed working on desktop + mobile)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow fully working. Backend lockout is 5 fails per (ip,email) with 15-min window — limit wrong-password tests to <=2 attempts per session. All testids present: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, login-error, page-title, total-saldo-display, logout-btn.
rca of the issue: Not a code bug. User tried unregistered personal gmail addresses. Only admin-seeded accounts exist (admin@hakusa.id). Login works correctly for the valid admin account; wrong credentials correctly show 'Email atau password salah'. Mitigation: communicate credentials to user, or add UI hint about closed account system.
